channel.title: QuickTiny — new tools and guides

item.title: Weighted Grade Calculator — Course Grade & Final Exam Needed
item.description: Calculate your weighted course grade from assignments and exams, see your grade so far, and find the score you need on the final. Free, private, no signup.

item.title: WebP to PNG Converter — Keep Transparency, Free
item.description: Convert WebP to PNG in your browser and keep transparent backgrounds. Batch conversion, ZIP download, no upload.

item.title: WebP to JPG Converter — Free & Private
item.description: Convert WebP images to JPG in your browser. Batch convert, pick a background color for transparent areas, download as ZIP. Nothing uploaded.

item.title: Unit Converter — cm to Inches, kg to lb, °C to °F & More
item.description: Free unit converter for length, weight, temperature, area (incl. feddan and dunam), volume, speed and data sizes. Instant results with every unit listed.

item.title: Saudi Salary & GOSI Calculator 2026 — Net Salary After Deductions
item.description: Calculate your net salary in Saudi Arabia after GOSI: basic + housing + transport, annuity and SANED rates for Saudis and expats, old and new system, plus employer cost.

item.title: Resize Image Online — Change Width, Height or Percent, Free
item.description: Resize photos to an exact width, height or percentage in your browser. Batch resize, keep aspect ratio, convert format at the same time. No upload.

item.title: Ramadan Timetable 2027 (1448) — Suhoor & Iftar Times for Your City
item.description: Printable Ramadan 2027 timetable for your city: Imsak (suhoor ends), Fajr, Iftar (Maghrib) and Isha for every day of the month, plus a countdown to Ramadan and Eid.

item.title: Ramadan Countdown 2027 — Days Until Ramadan, Iftar & Suhoor Timer
item.description: How many days until Ramadan 2027? A live countdown for your city, then a second-by-second iftar and suhoor timer during Ramadan with today's Imsak, Maghrib and fasting hours.

item.title: Qibla Direction — Find the Qibla From Your Location
item.description: Find the Qibla direction from your current location or city in degrees from north, plus the distance to the Kaaba and today's prayer times. Free, no app needed.

item.title: Pregnancy Due Date Calculator — How Many Weeks Pregnant Am I?
item.description: Estimate your due date from your last period (with cycle length) or conception date, see how many weeks pregnant you are and key milestone dates. Free and private.
